name: Lasty's mom
source:
Lasty's mother, an unlucky woman who became a widow at a young age. She usually works for the church because her husband used to work there. She is an ideal mom who is kind and supportive of her daughter. Many have become her fans after seeing her holding a ladle in the kitchen. There are quite a few men who secretly yearn for her.

[Translated from the game's [url=https://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/as/char.htm]Official Homepage[/url]].

[spoiler]Name: Shirley Farson (シアリィ＝ファースン) [/spoiler]
